The name

Latin for earth, Spanish for sky. Every elevation in between.

Terra speaks to investors who want land-level assets they can improve and resell. Cielo speaks to buyers who want the view from the top. We built one brokerage so you never have to change advisers when your ambitions change altitude.

Elevation 0 – 30 m

TerraGrounded assets, built value

  • Villa flips in established communities: we price the renovation before you buy the house.
  • Townhouses in Dubai Hills, Arabian Ranches, Town Square and Jumeirah Village Circle.
  • Plots and ready homes with gardens, pools and room to grow a family.
Elevation 150 – 400 m

CieloHigh-rise, ultra-luxury, all view

  • Penthouses and sky villas in Downtown, Dubai Marina, Business Bay and Palm Jumeirah.
  • Branded residences and off-plan launches with developer payment plans.
  • Private viewings, discreet off-market access, and full-floor opportunities.

Leadership

Bigyan Pandey

Founder & Chief Executive Officer

I started Terra & Cielo because buying property in Dubai should feel simple and honest. Whether you want a villa with a garden or an apartment high above the city, you should be able to speak to one person who understands both.

I take the time to understand what you actually want, tell you plainly what I would do in your position, and stay in touch long after the keys are handed over.

Call me or send a message on WhatsApp. I answer personally.

“Good property advice is simple. Be honest about the numbers, be patient with the decision, and be there when the client needs you.”Bigyan Pandey
